video_title: Micah Nori Postgame Interview | Trail Blazers 118, Warriors 128 | Oct. 16, 2026

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori on team goals and preseason progress
quotes.excerpt: wanted to come in and just establish what we were trying to do as a group
quotes.quote: For the most part, I wanted to come in and just establish what we were trying to do as a group with the turnover. I feel that the guys have been great. Their approach to everyday as far as practice, I think their game approach to the games and what we're trying to do and trying to get done what we're asking them to do has been very good. And I think like most teams, you get through the preseason relatively healthy is big for us as well, I think for everybody. But I really feel good at where we're at.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori says he feels good about where the Trail Blazers are at after the preseason, noting that the team has been great in their approach to practice and game execution.

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori on Ja Morant's role and fit with the team
quotes.excerpt: we're getting Ja Morant at the right time
quotes.quote: I think that we're getting Ja Morant at the right time. And what I mean by that is he's coming to a situation where he feels like he has an opportunity to win basketball games again. And I think that the group that we have around him is very good. As far as I'm talking about the leadership people that are on the team, the shooting that's around him, the bigs that are around him. So I think that he's going to be in a position where he's going to be successful. And we know what he's capable of. And I think the one good thing when you talk to Denny, last year Denny as an All-Star had to do a lot of things by himself because of all the injuries that the Trail Blazers had. And now what we're able to do and adding willing passers like Ja allows him to basically get off the ball a little bit more. And I think that you've seen this preseason, maybe not as many shots for Denny, but he's been able to be much more efficient.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori believes adding Ja Morant to the roster will help Denny become more efficient by allowing him to get off the ball more. Nori says the team is getting Morant at the right time.

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori on Damian Lillard's return and role
quotes.excerpt: there's really no loss of his, not to say explosiveness, but his quickness in that
quotes.quote: He's getting to the free throw line, so that means he's getting himself downhill. Gets 13 free throw attempts, so there's really no loss of his, not to say explosiveness, but his quickness in that. But the other thing is, like I tell people, you know he hurt his lower body, not his upper body. He can still shoot the thing. So his game is not reliant on all that quickness. It's just more of him getting shots and us finding space for him. And I think the one difference that you'll see with Dame now is he'll be off the ball a little bit more than what he was earlier in his career. We can still play him obviously in pick and roll, we'd be idiots not to, but he doesn't have to do all that and we're able to find him open shots more so in the flow. And you see him competing at the defensive end as well.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori says Damian Lillard will play off the ball more this season. Nori notes that while Lillard is still effective in pick and roll, the team wants to find him more open shots in the flow of the offense.

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori on Hansson's performance and development
quotes.excerpt: Hansson needs to play high-level basketball
quotes.quote: He goes three for four and he gets himself seven rebounds, three of them offensive, so we like that. And I think his first run, we put him in a little bit of a tough spot because it was Horford and then Horford was able to make I think three of his threes against him, but it was just because he was down the floor. But that's on us, that's not on him. So I was very happy with Hansson's play. I think the one thing that we want to make sure, as we got to him 20 minutes tonight, Hansson needs to play high-level basketball and just as the more he gets used to the speed, the length, and the activity of the NBA game, the better he's going to be. Because the one thing that his skill level is being a hub, being a passer, that type of guy and the more he sees and feels it and plays, the better off he's going to be. So Hansson was great.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori praised Hansson for his performance against the Warriors, highlighting his rebounding and skill as a passer. Nori says the goal is for Hansson to continue adjusting to the speed and length of the NBA game.
